notes.title: Demo: Big update July 23
notes.notes:
Hey folks,



we just released the biggest update to the demo ever!

The initial release of the demo exceeded our expectations by far and we were super happy to see how many people played the game and enjoyed it. But through your direct feedback and while watching various videos and streams of the demo, we also saw some stuff that needs improvement. And that's what this update is about!
Patchnotes
Reworked and rebalanced over 30 heroes to create more variety in strong builds

Added weekly decks which gives you a curated deck every week and you will only face opponents with the same weekly deck

Added health kit which restores your lifes in round 3 so that the randomness of the first 2 rounds doesn't hurt your endgame

Enabled opponent preview also in ranked games

Added a list showing new player rewards which were unlocked when returning to main menu

Various quality of life improvements and fixes

notes.title: Demo: Big localization update
notes.notes:
Hey folks,



we just added localization for the following languages:

French

Italian

Turkish

Russian

Traditional Chinese



We also added some small improvements to the UI and made sure that the texts are pretty in every language. Plus, there are some small quality of life features and fixes to the game.



Hope you will enjoy it!

We're already working on a bigger update gameplay update which will adjust many characters to enable even more synergies. Stay tuned!

notes.title: The Playtest just received a massive update
notes.notes:
We just released a massive update for the Playtest a few days ago. Now that all the bugs the community found are also fixed we want to give you an overview of all the major changes:

 Added 14 new characters
 Added new stack Thorns: When the character gets attacked, deal the amount of stacks as damage to the attacker and reduce the stack by 1
 Updated Freeze stack: Freezing is now chance based, every stack gives the character a 10% chance of getting frozen for a round
 Rebalanced characters and changed some character effects
 Fixed a crash in battle
 Fixed crash when using the "Randomize" button in the deck menu
 Fixed slot count bug when killing and spawning characters in the shop
 Fixed bug with wrong health/attack shown after leveling up characters sometime
 Fixed idle animation for Toad Lvl 2
 Fixed Necromancer summoning a new Skeleton when a Skeleton died; this lead to infinite Skeletons until the Necromancer died
 A lot of smaller bug fixes 
 Added many smaller quality of life improvements
